name: Charged Armor
body:
School conjuration (creation) [force]; Level bloodrager 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, unchained summoner 5, witch 5

CASTING

Components V, S, M (diamond dust worth 250 gp)
Duration 10 min./level or until discharged

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser charged armor except as above, the DR is increased to 10, the amount per level is increased to 10 points per level (maximum 200), and it explodes out to 10 feet to a maximum of 15d4 force damage.
